claim: P2: number of active latent units of overcomplete VAEs vs pre-fixed target counts (bits, per-block factors, affine dimension, facts) on raw Blocksworld states (Bernoulli decoder) and on exp46 transformer activations (Gaussian decoder); also owns the shared training sweep reused by pw03 and pw04
hypothesis: H2.2 (merges former H2.1): every competence-gated beta=1 Bernoulli VAE on raw states has AU < 25 (affine dimension), and across architectures AU on Blocksworld behaves like the information target (seed median within 2 units of a 10-bit/10-factor redundant-code control and >2 units below a 12.9-bit/5-factor product control) in >= 3 of 4 architectures. H2.3: at beta=1, AU varies across architecture x lr by >= 3 units and more than across seeds. H2.4: on the state-explained activation substrate b_lin, a Gaussian decoder with learned variance switches on >= 2 more units than with fixed variance at each of 5 source checkpoints (widths 64/128/256; width 128 at three transformer seeds).

sampling.unit: independent VAE/SAE training seed (init, minibatch order, reparameterization noise; run RNG seed derived from sha256(cell_id|seed))
sampling.per_cell: sweep_grid.json lists the confirmation seeds of every cell
sampling.justification: 5 seeds for the 24 raw-state bw-gauss_vae cells (core of H2.2/H2.3 and the comparators of pw03 H3.2 and pw04 H4.1/H4.2); 3 for controls, secondary families and activation cells (budget). Claims use a fixed 2-unit tolerance plus non-overlap of seed ranges. Transformer sources are fixed substrates; width 128 is replicated over three exp46 seeds (s1-s3), widths 64/256 use s1 only.

uncertainty: All per-seed counts reported; seed medians and ranges per cell (passing seeds only for required cells); differences claimed only beyond 2 units with non-overlapping seed ranges. With 5 seeds the within-cell range is a stricter yardstick for H2.3 than with 3 (expected range of 5 vs 3 normal draws: 2.33 vs 1.69 sd). Complete separation of 5 vs 5 seeds has exact one-sided permutation p = 1/252, 5 vs 3 p = 1/56, 3 vs 3 p = 1/20 (reported, not used as criteria). Descriptive two-way variance decomposition (arch, lr; residual = seed). No p-value criteria.

splits.development: thesis blocksworld_train file split by sequence with seed 0 into train (12,803) and val (3,201); (b) subsamples 3,000 train and 500 val sequences
splits.confirmation: thesis blocksworld_test file (4,001 sequences; (b) uses a fixed 300-sequence subsample), sealed until the full run; on raw states the support is identical across splits, so independent seeds 1-5 / 1-3 (vs pilot seed 101) are the effective confirmation unit

selection_rule: No selection: every cell's final checkpoint at step 30,000 is analyzed; no early stopping, no best-seed choice, thresholds fixed in advance.
stopping_rule: Per-run crash/NaN: one same-seed re-run, logged; second failure = technical stop for that run. Experiment-level competence_stop if any cell entering a required criterion has fewer than a majority of its planned seeds passing competence (3 of 5, 2 of 3). Grid/steps/gate changes after freeze require an amendment directory. Pre-registered A3 contingency (PROTOCOL.md section 10): if any A3 cell on raw-state-type data (bw/code10/prod5, beta=1, lr 3e-4) fails per-run competence in pilot_001, a linear KL warm-up (beta from 0 to target over the first 10% of steps) is applied to ALL cells; it is exercised in pilot_002 (seed 101, same pilot cells, development data) and the full run cites pilot_002; a pilot_002 gate failure stops the run.
controls: code10 data (10 independent bits, redundantly coded): positive control with known count
prod5 data (5 independent 6-valued one-hot blocks): same per-block coding and affine dim as Blocksworld, no legality constraints
indep data (independent bits with Blocksworld marginals): no-structure negative control
plain autoencoder: AU-metric control (no KL term)
PCA counts on every substrate: linear baseline
fixed-gamma Gaussian decoder vs learned gamma on (b), 5 source checkpoints
b_lin (state-explained activations) vs b_raw: non-state content control
grid: experiments/pw02_active_units/sweep_grid.json (66 cells, 246 confirmation runs: 24 cells x 5 seeds + 42 cells x 3 seeds; 23 pilot cells at seed 101)
